rendered: The anode-free sodium full cell with a presodiated pyrite cathode reaches ∼400 Wh/kg[1]. The paper gives the theoretical maximum for LiCoO2/graphite cells as 387 Wh/kg[2], so the anode-free cell exceeds that figure by about 13[3] Wh/kg (a difference of rounded figures, so approximate). The state-of-the-art sodium-ion full cells the paper cites demonstrate only ∼200 Wh/kg[4] with respect to active mass.
